name: Healing Potion
description: Steadies the hands before a fight. Increases quest success rate.

name: Supreme Healing Potion
description: Steadies the hands before a fight. Increases quest success rate more than a standard healing potion.

name: Greater Healing Potion
description: Steadies the hands before a fight. Increases quest success rate more than a standard healing potion.

name: Grand Healing Potion
description: Steadies the hands before a fight. A serious dose, well past what a standard potion offers.

name: Phoenix Draught
description: Bottled resolve. The strongest success bonus coin can buy.

name: Minor Lucky Potion
description: Coins seem to find their way into pockets.

name: Standard Lucky Potion
description: Coins seem to find their way into pockets.

name: Grand Lucky Potion
description: Coins seem to find their way into pockets, and then some.

name: Greater Lucky Potion
description: Coins seem to find their way into pockets, and then some. A stronger brew than the Grand tier.

name: Fortune's Bounty
description: Every pocket on this hero is somehow already full before they've left the guild hall.

name: Strength Potion
description:
A hard swing and a fair price for it.
Increases success rate, and gold drops

name: Grand Strength Potion
description: A hard swing and a fair price for it. Hits harder than a standard Strength Potion.

name: Titan's Draught
description: A hard swing and a fair price for it. The strongest brew the Alchemist stocks.

name: Protection Charm
description: Your knight comes home unhurt, win or lose.

name: Elixir of Fortune
description: Guarantees a favourable event on the road.

name: Field Bandage
description: Clears one injury immediately.

name: Restorative Draught
description: Restores a portion of Health immediately. Doesn't revive a Fallen hero -- see the Infirmary or pay to revive directly.

name: Greater Restorative Draught
description: Restores a large portion of Health immediately. Doesn't revive a Fallen hero -- see the Infirmary or pay to revive directly.

name: Guardian's Retainer
description: Equip before sending a hero out. Softens whatever this quest is about to do to them, rather than patching it up afterward.

name: Pet Treat
description: Crafted, not foraged -- a pet's own happiness bar goes up further per treat than raw scraps would give it. Fed directly from the Hatchery's Pets tab, not sent out on quests -- carries no quest effect.

name: Beckoning Charm
description: Smells like whatever Grimsby is currently burning to cover up whatever he's actually selling. Somehow, it works -- his cart tends to show up sooner after one of these gets used.

name: Minor Fortune Charm (Gold)
description: A faint pull toward coin. Loot drops on this quest are a little more likely to roll Gold.

name: Fortune Charm (Gold)
description: A real pull toward coin. Loot drops on this quest are noticeably more likely to roll Gold.

name: Grand Fortune Charm (Gold)
description: A strong pull toward coin. Loot drops on this quest lean hard toward Gold.

name: Greater Fortune Charm (Gold)
description: Coin, above all else. Loot drops on this quest are heavily biased toward Gold.

name: Boundless Fortune Charm (Gold)
description: Coin, and nothing else. Every loot drop on this quest that rolls procedurally rolls Gold on every affix.

name: Minor Fortune Charm (Insight)
description: A faint pull toward understanding. Loot drops on this quest are a little more likely to roll Experience.

name: Fortune Charm (Insight)
description: A real pull toward understanding. Loot drops on this quest are noticeably more likely to roll Experience.

name: Grand Fortune Charm (Insight)
description: A strong pull toward understanding. Loot drops on this quest lean hard toward Experience.

name: Greater Fortune Charm (Insight)
description: Understanding, above all else. Loot drops on this quest are heavily biased toward Experience.

name: Boundless Fortune Charm (Insight)
description: Understanding, and nothing else. Every loot drop on this quest that rolls procedurally rolls Experience on every affix.

name: Alchemist's Reserve
description: Home-brewed rather than shelf-bought. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.

name: Phoenix Ember
description: A guttering coal of the real thing. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.

name: Trail Rations
description: Smoked fish and dried herbs, packed for a hero who won’t be home for dinner. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.

name: Herbal Tonic
description: The Herb Garden’s own cure-all, brewed in-house rather than bought off a vendor's shelf. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.

name: Forager's Bundle
description: Wild berries and whatever else looked worth picking along the treeline. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.

name: Meal On The Go
description: Hearty, meat n' veg stew, ladled out before the road. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.

name: Warband Feast
description: Enough food to feed a war party, cooked for one hero heading out alone. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.

name: Prospector's Cache
description: A handful of ore and river silt, panned rather than paid for. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.

name: Dragon's Hoard Charm
description: Smells faintly of brimstone and old coin. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.

name: Lucky Charm (Gold)
description: A rough-cut equivalent to the Alchemist's own Fortune Charms. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.

name: Lucky Charm (Insight)
description: A rough-cut equivalent to the Alchemist's own Fortune Charms. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.

name: Fortune Weave (Gold)
description: Ore and herb, worked into the same trick the Alchemist's own charms use. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.

name: Fortune Weave (Insight)
description: Ore and herb, worked into the same trick the Alchemist's own charms use. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.

name: Windfall Sigil (Gold)
description: The strongest pull toward coin the Enchanter's bench can manage. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.

name: Windfall Sigil (Insight)
description: The strongest pull toward understanding the Enchanter's bench can manage. Craft-only -- not sold at the Alchemist's stall.
